# Spec Requirements-Quality Checklist: Frontend restructure — by-screen features, design-system port, board screen

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements in `spec.md` — completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability and coverage of the FRs, user stories and success criteria (including how the G1–G9 rulings are encoded). Tests the spec's writing, not the implementation.
**Created**: 2026-09-23 (spec-domain run, reviewer seat)
**Feature**: [../spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Is each of the nine GATE-1 rulings (G1–G9) reflected in at least one FR or user story, with none living only in the "Resolved decisions" narrative? [Completeness, Spec §Binding rulings / §Requirements]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is every operator-visible behaviour of the Board tab (task list, selection detail, evidence section, timeline, artifact versions, counter strip, disabled Gates/Cost tabs) covered by an FR clause rather than only by the user story? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021 / US-3]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are requirements defined for a board that answers successfully but with zero tasks for this run (empty task list, zeroed counter strip, detail-pane state)? [Gap, Spec §FR-021 / SC-006]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements specified for transient board API failures mid-session (one failed fetch while the tab is open) as distinct from the three permanent unavailability conditions — banner, retry, or connection-lost discipline? [Gap, Spec §FR-022 / §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the board tab's polling cadence and start/stop discipline specified, or explicitly delegated to the run-graph discipline FR-023 cites? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are accessibility requirements (keyboard navigation of the tab host, disabled-tab semantics, list-row selection focus) specified or explicitly ruled out of scope? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "empty-ready" (the board folder's state after group A, FR-001) defined precisely enough that a plan task can verify it without interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is "behaviour-neutral" for group A operationalized (same DOM test ids, same routes, no assertion edits) rather than left as prose intent? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "adopted wholesale" for the token files precise about precedence when the ported files conflict with repo conventions (R7)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009 / §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the URL shape for the active tab (query parameter vs path segment) specified so "a copied board URL reopens on the Board tab" is testable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017 / SC-005]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the counter strip's "this run" label specified as exact copy a presentation test can assert? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021 / G5c]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 - Is SC-002's "zero skipped-by-this-change tests" verifiable as written (can a checker distinguish skips introduced by this change from pre-existing skips)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK018 - Can SC-001 ("locate all of its code by reading one table row and opening one folder") be objectively verified for the board screen between groups A and C, while the folder is still empty? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001 / FR-001]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 - Primary flows: do acceptance scenarios cover all four existing routes' post-restructure rendering, not just Run detail? [Coverage, Spec §US-1 / FR-007]
- [ ] CHK022 - Alternate flows: is direct deep-linking to the Board tab (no prior Graph visit in the session) covered alongside switching from Graph? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017 / US-3]
- [ ] CHK023 - Exception flows: is "a server without the board surface" defined for production (same-origin) as well as for the dev proxy, so FR-022's third condition is testable in both modes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022 / FR-020b]
- [ ] CHK024 - Recovery flows: if the board becomes available again after showing the unavailability banner, is the banner's clearing (re-probe on tab reselect vs permanent) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK025 - Non-functional scenarios: beyond the 1000-line ceiling, are performance expectations for large boards (task count, timeline length, per-key version fetches) specified or consciously excluded? [Coverage, Spec §FR-025 / §Edge cases]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are the Graph tab's retained banner test ids and wording specified as frozen so FR-018's "unchanged" is assertable? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018 / §Edge cases]
